topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture structure, learning objectives, and historical framework for studying the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and pathway deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinases, Wnt/beta-catenin, and other signaling cascades enable cancer cells to achieve growth signal independence and resist inhibitory cues.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how differentiation arrest sustains proliferative progenitor states across hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal epithelial carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis through p53 and Bcl-2 family regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the molecular mechanisms, including p53 inactivation and Bcl-2 balance, that allow cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence bypass, and cellular stress responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how telomere maintenance and p53-mediated stress pathways govern cellular senescence and enable cancer cells to achieve limitless replicative potential.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the metabolic adaptations of cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis and Krebs cycle mutations that generate epigenetic-modifying oncometabolites.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how developing tumors overcome diffusion limits by activating the angiogenic switch to stimulate new blood vessel growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genomics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the multi-step cascade of metastatic dissemination, circulating tumor cell monitoring, seed-and-soil dynamics, and metastatic genomic profiles.

topics.label: Concluding summary and remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with overarching reflections on the hallmarks framework and final housekeeping remarks.
